title: Pi UI Tweaks settings
description: Settings for Pi interactive-interface behavior and presentation tweaks.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for this settings file.

autocompleteAboveInput.description: Render autocomplete above the input editor.

bashExecPromptSpacing.description: Add spacing around bash execution prompts.

anchorInputToBottom.description: Anchor the input editor to the terminal bottom.

compactStartup.description: Show a compact startup header; expand tools to reveal native help and loaded resources.

dimInputBorder.description: Dim the input editor's horizontal border lines.

hideModelProviderHint.description: Hide provider hints in the model selector.

hideSlashCommandSourceTags.description: Hide source tags in slash-command completion.

model.description: Exact native model ID, not its display alias.

openRouterBillingConfirmed.description: For or only: you confirm OpenRouter billing (not BYOK) and no extension or proxy changes the configured routing.

schedule.title: OffPeakSchedule
schedule.description: Selecting a schedule asserts the exact billing route, plan, region, endpoint, offer validity and no ineligible fallback. Only documented model IDs are accepted; or requires live OpenRouter metadata and verified Pi routing.

offPeakRules.description: Opt in only after verifying the exact billing route, plan, model, endpoint, region and active offer. deepseek-reseller is OpenCode Go only; command is Command; glm is the Coding Plan; qwen is Alibaba Global PAYG; ali-qwen is eligible Alibaba personal Token Plan; ali-deepseek is eligible Alibaba PAYG or Token Plan; mimo is Token Plan. or requires verified OpenRouter routing and live endpoint metadata.

holiday.description: True for a public holiday, false for a confirmed ordinary date.

deepseekHolidayCalendar.description: Authoritative Chinese public-holiday status by date for direct DeepSeek: true is a holiday, false is not. Unknown dates suppress predictions that depend on them. Keep dates current; reseller schedules do not use this calendar.

pinnedModels.description: Pinned models in display order, each as provider/native-model-id (including virtual model IDs); aliases and display names do not change the key.

mainScreenSynchronizedOutput.description: Present regular-mode content and final cursor updates in one synchronized-output frame.

neutralBorderColor.description: Use a neutral border color when Pi is idle.

pasteCollapseCharThreshold.description: Character threshold that collapses pasted content.

pasteCollapseExpandKey.description: Explicit key used to expand collapsed pasted content.

pasteCollapseLineThreshold.description: Line threshold that collapses pasted content.

pasteCollapseUseToolExpandKey.description: Reuse Pi's configured tool-expansion key for pasted content.

preserveCompactionHistory.description: Keep pre-compaction messages visible in transcript history.

restoreContentAfterAutocompleteClose.description: Restore editor content after closing autocomplete.

refreshTmuxHyperlinks.description: Refresh Markdown links when a tmux client attaches or detaches.

selectedOptionPrefix.description: Prefix displayed before selected list options.
